# Clinekt Health

> Clinekt Health is a patient engagement company. Our AI agents answer, book and bring back patients for specialty medical practices and health systems, and they book every appointment directly into the practice's existing EHR schedule. Practices go live the same day. White-labeled to each practice, HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II, AES-256.

Who it is for: practice administrators, owner physicians and health-system access leaders in orthopedics, physical therapy, oral surgery, dentistry, dermatology, ophthalmology, urology, primary care, cardiology, pediatrics, rheumatology, behavioral health, OB/GYN and gastroenterology, and health systems that run those service lines.

What the agents do:
- Inbound Agent: answers every new patient and every referral by phone, text, email and website chat, day and night, books the visit, and verifies insurance eligibility before the visit.
- Recall Agent: finds overdue and dormant patients in the practice's EHR automatically and holds a conversation by phone, text and email until the visit is booked or the patient says no.
- Outbound Agent: brings in net-new patients and traces each one from first click to completed visit.
- Care Agent: asks every patient for an NPS score and a Google review, runs monthly check-ins and outcome surveys between visits, escalates concerns to staff, and documents the work so practices can bill Medicare care management.

Clinekt is not a chatbot, a contact form, or a reminder blast: its Recall Agent is patient reactivation software that finds overdue patients in the EHR and books them back by conversation.

How booking works: the agent holds the conversation until the patient has a confirmed time with the right provider, then books the appointment directly into the practice's existing EHR schedule with the conversation attached, so the team sees it on the calendar it already uses. Anything clinical, anything urgent, and anything the patient asks to take to a person goes to the practice's team. EHRs: Epic, athenahealth, ModMed, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, Cerner (Oracle Health), AdvancedMD, Greenway, Veradigm and Nextech; in dental practices, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental and Denticon. No IT project; month to month, no long-term contract.

Proof: Ventura Orthopedics, a five-location orthopedic group in California, had more than 300 completed appointments in its first month live with Clinekt, more than 200 of them with patients new to the practice, verified in eClinicalWorks. Baldwin Bone and Joint, a multi-provider orthopedic group, generated 263 qualified surgical leads and 159 booked appointments with a 60% lead-to-appointment rate in a single quarter. Across the platform: +12% appointment volume after go-live, more than 1 million patient interactions, and 82% of patients try to book outside office hours, when nobody is there to answer.

What the agents handle: scheduling and booking, appointment reminders, inbound call management (answering phones and website inquiries), enrollment and intake, insurance verification, billing questions and balances, referrals, recall and reactivation, patient retention, medication adherence reminders, and marketing attribution. Built into every agent: HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type II, phone, text, and email in one thread, customizable voices, multiple languages, a real-time dashboard, and one memory of every patient. Practices go live the same day with no IT project.

How to start: book a 15-minute demo at https://clinekthealth.com/book-a-demo. We show the agents working under your own brand and answer security and EHR questions up front.

## Platform

- [Clinekt Health home](https://clinekthealth.com/): AI agents for patient engagement that book new patients, bring back overdue ones, and follow up between visits, with every appointment booked directly into the practice's existing EHR schedule.
- [Platform overview](https://clinekthealth.com/platform): one platform, one brain, every patient activated; the patient journey and every agent
- [Inbound Agent](https://clinekthealth.com/inbound-agent): answers every new patient instantly, screens in about two minutes, books qualified patients around the clock
- [Recall Agent](https://clinekthealth.com/recall-agent): finds overdue and lapsed patients in practice records and books them back with real conversations by phone, text, and email
- [Outbound Agent](https://clinekthealth.com/outbound-agent): net-new patient demand with end-to-end attribution from ad click to completed procedure
- [Care Agent](https://clinekthealth.com/care-agent): care and reputation between visits: asks every patient for an NPS score and a Google review, runs monthly check-ins and validated outcome surveys (HOOS Jr, KOOS Jr), escalates concerns to staff, and documents the work so practices can bill Medicare care management.

## Questions buyers ask

- **Would these patients have booked anyway?** 82% of patients try to book outside office hours, when nobody answers. The agents answer in that moment and book the visit, and the Recall Agent reaches overdue and dormant patients in the practice's records, who are not on its website at all. At Ventura Orthopedics the result was counted as completed visits in the practice's own eClinicalWorks records, with new patients counted separately from existing ones.
- **Who books the appointment?** The agent books the appointment directly into the practice's existing EHR schedule.
- **Will Clinekt sign a business associate agreement (BAA)?** Yes. Clinekt signs a BAA with every client, and data handling follows that agreement. All patient data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
- **What happens when a patient describes something urgent?** The agents do not give medical advice. Anything clinical, anything urgent, and anything the patient asks to take to a person goes to the practice's team with the full conversation attached, so staff decides what happens next.
- **Is Clinekt priced per user, per location, or per appointment?** Per provider. One simple rate per provider per month, with support and tuning included, month to month, with no long-term contract.
- **Can patients opt out of calls and texts?** Yes. The agent says what it is when asked, and it stops the moment a patient asks it to. Text messages follow the consent and opt-out terms in the Terms of Service: https://clinekthealth.com/terms-of-service
- More answers: https://clinekthealth.com/faqs
